docs.title: Overview
docs.attribution: © vuejs/core contributors — MIT License, via docs-mesh
docs.snippet: @vue/compat (aka "the migration build") is a build of Vue 3 that provides configurable Vue 2 compatible behavior.

docs.title: Intended Use Cases
docs.attribution: © vuejs/core contributors — MIT License, via docs-mesh
docs.snippet: - Upgrading a Vue 2 application to Vue 3 (with limitations) - Migrating a library to support Vue 3 - For experienced Vue 2 developers who have not tried Vue 3 yet, the migration build can be used in place of Vue 3 to help learn the difference between versions.

docs.title: Known Limitations
docs.attribution: © vuejs/core contributors — MIT License, via docs-mesh
docs.snippet: While we've tried hard to make the migration build mimic Vue 2 behavior as much as possible, there are some limitations that may prevent your app from being eligible for upgrading:

docs.attribution: © vuejs/core contributors — MIT License, via docs-mesh
